description: Manage the world model — rooms, things, exits, and their spatial properties. create and update mutate in place and persist to the Novel; all mutations are audited; remove is permanent and requires re-creation; convert replaces the described subtree; generate creates rooms from installed table pools bounded by TTRPG_WORLD_GEN_MAX_ROOMS. create_exit links both directions; create_thing honors location_type only when location is set, and kind forces property defaults. There are no read-only actions here; inspect state with run_command (action: execute). Use when: creating, updating, removing, bulk-converting, or generating locations and objects. Do NOT use when: navigating the world — use run_command (action: execute); proposing objective-state transitions — use manage_causality; recording what an entity believes — use manage_belief.

action.description: World: create_room, update_room, remove_room, create_thing, update_thing, remove_thing, create_exit, remove_exit, convert, or generate. Causal: causal_propose, causal_admit, causal_reject, causal_list, causal_state, or causal_ingress.

climbable.description: When true the thing can be climbed (create_thing/update_thing).

drinkable.description: When true the thing can be drunk (create_thing/update_thing).

edible.description: When true the thing can be eaten (create_thing/update_thing).

enterable.description: When true the thing can be entered (create_thing/update_thing).

fixed.description: When true the thing cannot be taken (create_thing/update_thing).

key.description: Bound key thing name required to unlock or lock this thing when lockable (create_thing/update_thing).

lit.description: When true the thing is lit (create_thing/update_thing).

lockable.description: When true the thing can be locked (create_thing/update_thing).

locked.description: When true the thing starts locked (create_thing/update_thing).

noise.description: Auditory cue text reported by listen (create_thing/update_thing).

openable.description: When true the thing can be opened (create_thing/update_thing).

options.description: Generation options (generate): roles maps installed table names to room, objects, persons, or hazards pools; rooms requests a count bounded by TTRPG_WORLD_GEN_MAX_ROOMS.

read_text.description: Text revealed when the thing is read (create_thing/update_thing).

readable.description: When true the thing can be read (create_thing/update_thing).

scent.description: Olfactory cue text reported by smell (create_thing/update_thing).

switchable.description: When true the thing can be switched (create_thing/update_thing).

switched_on.description: When true the thing is switched on (create_thing/update_thing).

transparent.description: When true the thing is transparent (create_thing/update_thing).

wearable.description: When true the thing can be worn (create_thing/update_thing).
